claim.value: When observability is the main obstacle, an instrumentation canary is a proposed next deployment action.
claim.scope: A conditional choice using surviving alternatives; observability is not asserted to be the actual main obstacle.

provenance.rationale: The span directly supplies the conditional instrumentation-canary choice and its role in choosing the next deployment.

signal_basis.value: The evidence comparison cannot discriminate among explanations, with missing phase timing or coverage information constituting the main obstacle. The proposed operation is an instrumentation canary collecting that missing information.
signal_basis.scope: Conditional information gathering when observability limits the comparison; the proposed canary has bounded sampling and logging overhead and collects no document contents.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the evidence comparison, the missing-information canary with its bounds, and the condition that observability is the main obstacle.
The claim is supported within its conditional scope; no unresolved empirical relation is required.

rationale: When missing observations prevent discrimination, a bounded deployment designed to collect those observations is licensed as a proposed next investigative action. The claim does not assert that the canary will resolve the uncertainty, identify a cause, or improve export performance.
uncertainty: Whether observability actually is the main obstacle and whether added instrumentation will discriminate remain open; neither is asserted by this conditional claim.
